about: Per-tape mixer pages 2, 3 and 4 and the tape speed: the master EQ's three values, the master effect and its eight values, the master compressor's four and the tape's speed are kept with each tape as the member save_mod, through level 7 of the base. A tape loaded takes its own; a tape with none takes the values the unit had at the start. It changes no place of the firmware and needs the base.
name: save mod
